definitions.explanation: A native speaker's command of Japanese — reading comprehension, vocabulary, writing, and the ability to express thoughts clearly. Discussed especially in education.

examples.english: I want to build up my Japanese language skills.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧ (national language; Japanese as a school subject) + {力|りょく} (ability). Refers to overall competence in one's native Japanese, not foreign-language skill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国語力|こくごりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to build language ability
- {国語力|こくごりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve language ability
- {国語力|こくごりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: language ability declines

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{語学力|ごがくりょく}→語学力：29443_gogakuryoku⟧: foreign-language ability — usually skill in a non-native language
- ⟦{読解力|どっかいりょく}→読解力：09290_dokkairyoku⟧: reading comprehension — one component of {国語力|こくごりょく}
